cors_origins.description: The origins a browser may call the API from, comma separated. Empty allows any.

referrer_policy.description: The Referrer-Policy header, when it names one.

permissions_policy.description: The Permissions-Policy header, when it names one.

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security: 1 for one year, or the header's own value.

csp.description: The Content-Security-Policy for everything no route or file policy covers.

csp_files.description: The Content-Security-Policy on served files. Empty keeps the built-in one.

csp_routes.description: <path glob>:<policy> entries separated by ;, the first match deciding.

csrf.description: double-submit requires the X-CSRF-Token header on a cookie request.

cross_origin.description: 1 sends Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy same-origin.
